name: THE HANGAR
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: A maintenance hangar is one open floor under a steel truss roof, its doors the whole front wall, big enough to take the aircraft whole with room to work round it.
A wide-body cargo jet is about 70 m long with a wingspan about the same; a fighter about 15 m long and 10 m across.

Round an aircraft in the hangar: tow tractors, ground power carts, boarding stairs, baggage and parts carts, engine stands, tool cribs along the walls; at an air base, munitions trailers and missile racks.

On house tiles the cargo jet is seven tiles of fuselage with its wings across five, and a fighter three tiles; the fuselage and the engines are tiles you cannot stand on, the wing's underside a crowd of jacks and hoses.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (hangar_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The airport's field and the air base are mostly runways and aprons with rows of hangars: about one fight in three there is fought inside a hangar, by the cell's own dice; the rest on the apron and the field.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The hangar's steel wall: no way through.

floor.effect: The hangar's painted concrete, oil-stained: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

nose.effect: The aircraft's nose on its gear: nobody stands there; cover for the tiles beside it. [bb] its boulder.

fuselage.effect: The fuselage, its skin panels off: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

tail.effect: The tail and its stabilizers: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

engine.effect: An engine hanging under the wing, its cowling open: nobody stands there; cover for the tiles beside it. [bb] its boulder.

wing.effect: Under the wing: jacks, fuel hoses and the landing gear: low cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
wing.say: Under the wing: low cover, slow going.

tug.effect: A tow tractor, low and heavy: cover.

gpu.effect: A ground power cart, dead: cover.

stairs.effect: Boarding stairs on their wheels: low cover.

carts.effect: Parts carts, picked over: low cover.

dollies.effect: Cargo dollies hitched in a train: low cover, and slow going over the hitches (3 AP).
dollies.say: Cargo dollies: low cover, slow going.

toolbox.effect: A rolling tool box: low cover.

enginestand.effect: A spare engine on its stand: cover.

crib.effect: A tool crib behind its cage, along the wall: nobody stands there. [bb] its wall.

munitions.effect: A munitions trailer, its racks empty: cover.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The hangar doors, rolled part open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The hangar doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in hangar_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: one floor; the wing is overhead, not a place to stand, and the stairs reach a door nobody can open.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the hangar's steel trusses and its dead light banks, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
